---
name: build-mac-cleaner
description: >-
  Use when the user wants a native macOS SwiftUI disk-cleaner app
  (CleanMyMac-style) built, rebuilt, extended, or debugged.
---
# Build a SwiftUI Mac cleaner app
Build a macOS 13+ SwiftUI app (generic name, no MacPaw names or assets) as a Swift Package with an executable target, plus an XcodeGen project.yml and a build.sh that runs `swift build`, writes Info.plist, assembles a .app and ad-hoc signs it.

Sections: Smart Scan; System Junk (~/Library/Caches, ~/Library/Logs, Xcode DerivedData/DeviceSupport/simulator caches, browser caches; Trash and Archives info-only/unselected); Large & Old Files and Duplicates (SHA-256, cancellable) over a saved folder list defaulting to ~/Downloads only; Uninstaller (.app in /Applications or ~/Applications, leftovers by exact bundle id only, no Group Containers, each unticked); Space Lens; Performance; Full Disk Access help; Settings > Safety with user Protected Folders.

Performance: live CPU, memory, disk stats; Free Up RAM button running `/usr/sbin/purge` with administrator privileges, showing memory freed; memory-heavy apps list (helpers summed per app, AI apps tagged) with Quit and Restart behind confirmation, Force Quit only after 10s and a second confirmation. These never touch files and never auto-quit.

Safety (mandatory): one SafetyGuard check used when listing and again right before FileManager.trashItem (never permanent delete), resolving symlinks. Deny-list blocks the path, its contents and ancestors: system paths, ~, ~/Library root, Documents, Desktop, Pictures, Movies, Music, iCloud (Mobile Documents, CloudStorage), Keychains, Mail, Messages, Photos, all home dotfolders, git repos, AI/agent data (Cursor, Claude, Codex, OpenAI/ChatGPT, Grok, Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, Continue, Aider, Copilot), and paths containing memory, agent, vault, backup, keychain, credentials, wallet, .env. Skip anything modified in the last 24 hours; never look inside build, dist, .build, node_modules, DerivedData; DerivedData unselected and blocked while Xcode runs. Never offer data files (.sqlite, .db, .json, .md, .plist) from app or hidden folders. Review list plus confirmation dialog; blocked items show a lock and reason.

Swift can't compile on a Linux box, so review carefully against macOS APIs, zip it, send it with steps (unzip, `./build.sh`, right-click Open first time, Xcode 15+), and ask for any build errors.

---
name: getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Mac cleaner bot.
---
I build and maintain a native Mac cleaner app (junk cleanup, large and duplicate files, uninstaller, disk map, Free Up RAM, and restarting frozen apps) that you build in Xcode.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which macOS version and Mac chip are you on, and is Xcode 15 or newer installed?
2. Any folders besides the built-in protections that must never be touched?
3. What should the app be called?

Save the answers as memories, then run build-mac-cleaner and send the zip with build steps.
